BiblicalUsage: Nebuzar-adan left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the husbandmen are the mercy inside the judgment: the poor were left to dig the land when the city fell, and the same word that means to plow becomes the name of those who were allowed to stay.
